memory.per_invocation_retained: Up to K x 50,331,648 B of unsharded block parameters held from each kept block's forward all-gather until its post-backward reshard, which runs before the SGD update. K=2 worst-aligned keep-window peak: 2,239,245,312 + 100,663,296 = 2,339,908,608 B, inside the 2,351,207,577 B cap with 11,298,969 B margin; K=1 adds at most 50,331,648 B.
memory.pools_and_graphs: No CUDA graphs, no stream or memory-pool changes, no persistent buffers; the retained unsharded tensors are ordinary FSDP allocations returned to the PyTorch caching allocator at each post-backward reshard, and the only cross-invocation state is the boolean policy flag itself.
memory.metric_scope: framework.peak_allocated_bytes (reset per run) is the gated metric and includes the keep window; framework.lifecycle_peak_allocated_bytes and lifecycle_peak_reserved_bytes also include preparation/installation and subsequent invocations. Nothing here moves allocation outside PyTorch counters, and no counter decrease is claimed as a physical-memory saving.

quality_risks: Numerical equivalence is a falsifiable claim, not a guarantee: no kernel shape, op order or reduction order changes and the removed all-gathers reproduce byte-identical buffers, so loss, complete logits, every DTensor-shard gradient and every post-update parameter must match the serial-global-batch reference at 1e-6/1e-4 over two continuous updates exactly as the source does; any mismatch or a passing logits+1 negative control falsifies the candidate (this is the gate the previous vocab-sharded attempt failed, for a cause this edit does not share).

Peak memory: the keep window adds up to K x 50,331,648 B; K=2's worst-aligned peak 2,339,908,608 B leaves 11,298,969 B under the 2,351,207,577 B cap, so parameter choices are restricted to {1, 2} and the measured peak gate decides; if K=2 measures over cap the search must select K=1 rather than publish a violation.

Policy effectiveness through the adapter's phase contexts: if the recaptured plan does not show the four backward-phase sites dropping from 24 to 24-K invocations, the policy did not act and no improvement is claimed.

Stale unsharded parameters at optimizer.step()/reset() would break SGD-on-shards semantics; excluded by the worker-verified FSDPParamGroup.reshard_after_backward=True default (post-backward reshard before the update) - the same lifecycle the root unit already proves in the passing source run - but this remains a runtime-verified property, not an assumption.

Runtime failure of the delegated parent forward is re-raised after a fallback.runtime_error label; it fails the invocation honestly rather than silently rerunning the parent, and the framework's parent-restore path handles it.

params.description: Number of trailing transformer blocks that skip the post-forward reshard (FSDPModule.set_reshard_after_forward(False, recurse=False)), eliminating that many ~2.0 ms serialized backward re-all-gathers while retaining up to 50,331,648 B of unsharded parameters per block from forward until post-backward reshard. The workload, quality thresholds, batch, sequence length, optimizer semantics and numerical policy are unchanged.

constraints.rationale: Cannot exceed the 24 transformer blocks of the frozen workload; the parameter only changes FSDP reshard timing, never workload semantics.

proposal.state_lifecycle: The replacement is the model-boundary forward during the adapter's forward_loss phase; the 24 FSDPGPT2Block units keep the parent forward and hooks. Kept blocks remain Shard(0) DTensor parameters for the whole warm-model lifecycle: within each step their unsharded buffers exist only from the forward all-gather to the post-backward reshard (FSDPParamGroup.reshard_after_backward default True), so the SGD update, reset()'s shard copies, verify()'s reference_shard comparisons and the tied transformer.wte.weight is lm_head.weight identity observe exactly the source layout; the boolean policy flag is the only cross-invocation state and every invocation re-executes the full workload on current inputs.
proposal.synchronization: Completion boundaries unchanged: the framework's leading and trailing torch.cuda.synchronize() still bracket zero_grad, the delegated parent forward, loss.backward() and the SGD update, and the step's detached loss and full logits remain alive through memory sampling. No extra barriers or manual serialization are introduced; collectives stay on the existing NCCL process group in unchanged order except that K backward re-gathers no longer launch, which removes work from the serialized wire chain rather than reordering it.
proposal.communication_plan: Per rank per step (world 2, NCCL, existing default process group): unchanged 24 forward block all-gathers (site b253f22b2d7834d96c0e4f7f), unchanged 24 gradient reduce-scatters, unchanged root all-gather and reduce-scatter; eliminated are the K trailing blocks' pre-backward re-all-gathers (~25,192,448 B contribution, ~1.99-2.08 ms serialized each) and their fsdp::all_gather_copy_in / fsdp::split_with_sizes_copy companions at the four run-phase sites listed in eliminated_calls (counts 24 -> 24-K). Expected kernel count 74 -> 74-K and communication_kernel_sum_ms / communication_union_ms down by ~K x 2.0 ms at timeline scale; communication_without_compute_ms should fall by the same amount while compute_overlap_ms is essentially unchanged.
